Alright, no gore, no spicy death threats! For Saturday night (assuming it's dinner before the movie), here are three **zero-gore, zero-spice** options that won't kill anyone:

1. **Classic Pasta with Marinara & Parmesan** — tomato sauce, garlic, and cheese. Everyone loves it, and it's mild.
2. **Sheet Pan Veggie & Cheese Bake** — zucchini, bell peppers, broccoli, and mozzarella on one tray. No sizzling, no gore.
3. **Simple Pizza Night** — store-bought dough or pre-made crust, tomato sauce, cheese, maybe some pepperoni (but skip the hot stuff). Everyone's a pizza fan.

If you want something specific I can pull up a full recipe for any of those, just say which one and what ingredients you've got on hand. Otherwise, pick your favorite and get cooking!
